_meta.about: Tier-level aggregate Achievement Diary requirements (Phase 4 / F2.3). Static, non-account-scoped reference data served from /public like quest-data.json. Entry shape per tier: s = aggregate skill levels (the highest level any task in that tier needs, per skill), cb = combat-level gate (Western Provinces only), q = quests that must be COMPLETED (verifiable against your ticked quest completions), reward = the unlock, note = extra caveats. The engine marks a tier 'ready' when every s/cb gate is met and every q quest is complete; 'locked' otherwise; 'done' when you've toggled it complete.
_meta.caveats: Skill levels are best-effort aggregates from oldschool.runescape.wiki and many are boostable. The q list only contains standard quests the hub can verify; miniquests (e.g. Enter the Abyss, Mage Arena I, Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl) and quests that only need to be STARTED are listed in `note` instead of `q`, so they never falsely lock a tier. Completion itself is all-or-nothing per tier and tracked by you ticking it — the hub answers 'can I do this now?', not 'which individual tasks have I done?'.
_meta.tasks: Each tier may carry an optional `tasks` array for per-task drill-down: { id (globally-unique stable key, used for completion ticks), t (task text), s? (notable per-task skill gate), q? (full quests required for that task), cb? (combat-level gate), note? (started/partial quests, miniquests, items, or other caveats not auto-verified) }. Per-task completion is a manual checklist (the game/Dink report only whole-tier completion). Curated regions so far: Lumbridge & Draynor, Varrock, Falador, Ardougne — the rest follow iteratively and show tier-level only until then.
_meta.source: Curated from oldschool.runescape.wiki diary pages (per-region requirement summaries + per-task tables).
